name: Bernice's Necklace
summary: At Stonefield Farm in Elwynn Forest, Bernice keeps her late husband's necklace close.

sections.title: A Soldier's Lost Charm
sections.body: Auntie Bernice Stonefield's necklace once belonged to her late husband, a veteran of Stormwind's military campaigns. He carried it into battle as a charm for good fortune. Bernice says tragedy came only during his final campaign, the one expedition when he forgot to bring it. Since his death, the keepsake has remained among her most cherished possessions at Stonefield Farm.

sections.title: Stolen by Scavengers
sections.body: Young Billy Maclure was exploring near the Fargodeep Mine when he dropped the shiny necklace. Goldtooth, a prominent kobold inside the mine, spotted it and carried it away. Like other kobolds, he was drawn to bright, valuable trinkets, and he kept the necklace among his scavenged treasures.

faq.answer: The necklace belonged to Auntie Bernice Stonefield's late husband, who wore it as a good-luck charm during Stormwind's military campaigns.

faq.q: How did the necklace end up with the kobolds?
faq.answer: Billy Maclure saw a large kobold with gold teeth pick up the necklace near the Fargodeep Mine and carry it away. Auntie Bernice hopes it can be recovered.

faq.q: Why is the necklace so important to Auntie Bernice?
faq.answer: The necklace is a cherished memory of Bernice's late husband. He believed it protected him in battle, and the only time he fell in war was the day he left it behind.
Goldtooth is a prominent kobold scavenger who makes his lair inside the Fargodeep Mine in Elwynn Forest. He collects shiny baubles and took the necklace after it was dropped nearby.

angles.text: For Alliance farm families in Elwynn Forest, the necklace recalls the toll Stormwind's long military campaigns take on everyday lives.
